notes: Card: no single token; peaks on 'toile|tries' after 'Free', 'paid' in 'all-expense paid trip', 'treatment' in 'Free treatment services', 'desay|unos' given as compensation, ',' in a list of fees covered. Near misses keep the same items but paid by the person.
